281367387.description:
Unbranded
Silver-Tone Metal Smoking Pipe
Traditional Asian Style, Vintage
This ornate smoking pipe features intricate silver-tone wirework and filigree decoration throughout the bowl and stem. The design incorporates traditional Asian motifs, including butterfly-like forms and floral appliques, characteristic of Miao or Hmong metalwork traditions. The elongated, curved stem is segmented by decorative bands and applied filigree, leading to a small, structured bowl area with scrolled wire details and a hanging decorative element.
Silver-tone metal construction with hand-applied filigree and wirework decoration
Traditional Asian design featuring butterfly and floral motifs characteristic of regional metalwork
Elongated curved stem with segmented decorative bands and ring-turned finials
Dimensions: 8.5" H x 3" W x 1" L
Condition:
Good vintage condition with significant natural patina and surface oxidation throughout, giving the metal a yellowish-green hue. No structural breaks or missing filigree elements are apparent. The mouthpiece and bowl opening show expected darkening from age and handling. The metal surfaces remain intact with no evidence of repair or structural damage.
